title: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation…
description: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) versions before 20261121.1943 contain a vulnerability where the LDAP synchronization connection check does not restrict the destination. This allows an authenticated API user to make the server connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, potentially sending crafted data to internal services.
